jobs.description: Production Worker (Early Shift)  As a Production Worker in the egg breaking department, you are responsible for operating and monitoring the machines that process eggs. You start your workday early in the morning at 05:00 by preparing the production line and setting up the machinery. Throughout the shift, you monitor the automated process that breaks eggs and separates egg whites from yolks, while performing quality and hygiene checks. At the end of the shift, you thoroughly clean the equipment and work environment together with your team, ensuring everything is ready for the next day. This is a position through Staffice at our client, with the prospect of a permanent contract after 3 months of full-time work! Responsibilities  -  Operating and monitoring the egg breaking and separation machines starting at 05:00  -  Checking the quality and separation of egg whites and egg yolks  -  Conducting regular visual quality and hygiene inspections during production  -  Cleaning and sanitizing production equipment and the work environment after production  -  Working efficiently alongside team members to ensure all daily batches are processed   Requirements  -  Great motivation, reliability, and a positive work attitude  -  Availability to start work early in the morning at 05:00  -  Willingness to work occasionally on Saturdays according to the team schedule  -  Ability to work until all planned daily processing is completed  -  Good command of the English or Dutch language   We offer  -  Working via Staffice at this client with the prospect of a permanent contract after 3 months  -  Gross hourly wage of € 14.99 per hour  -  Weekly payment of your salary and flexible payment options  -  25 holiday days based on a full-time contract  -  8% holiday allowance  -  Travel allowance for your daily commute  -  Personal guidance and support from Staffice throughout your employment  -  Een leuke werksfeer is gegarandeerd.
